architecture.css_design_system: :root { --bg: #0f1115; --card: #16181d; --border: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15); --text: #f1f5f9; --accent: #94a3b8; } body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; margin: 0; } .app-layout { display: flex; min-height: 100vh; } .sidebar { width: 220px; background: #121418; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 20px; } .content-area { flex: 1; padding: 24px; overflow-y: auto; } .kpi-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; } .kpi-card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 18px; }
architecture.js_state_machine: const dataset = [ { name: 'Auth Gateway', latency: '24ms', uptime: '99.98%', status: 'Healthy' }, { name: 'Neural Inference Engine', latency: '68ms', uptime: '99.91%', status: 'Healthy' }, { name: 'Vector Database RAG', latency: '112ms', uptime: '99.85%', status: 'Warning' } ]; function renderTable(items) { const tbody = document.getElementById('tableBody'); tbody.innerHTML = items.map(i => `${i.name}${i.latency}${i.uptime}${i.status}`).join(''); } document.getElementById('tableFilter').addEventListener('input', (e) => { const q = e.target.value.toLowerCase(); renderTable(dataset.filter(d => d.name.toLowerCase().includes(q))); }); renderTable(dataset);
